edits.value_json: 四 means ‘four.’ Its current 囗 enclosure surrounds inner 儿-form strokes. Early 亖 also directly wrote four and coexisted with 四 forms; counting rods are a separate proposal. Other proposals link 四 to breath-related 呬 or nasal-discharge 泗, then borrowing for four; 泗 lacks textual attestation, and the breath referent’s name is unknown.
